description: Replaces the parts of a LiveDoc with the supplied part list. This can remove or replace existing content, so read the current structure with `getDocumentParts` and use `dry_run` before writing. Use `moveDocumentParts` to reposition existing parts while retaining their identities. Effect: irreversible — data removed or overwritten by this call cannot be recovered through the API. Tip: set `dry_run: true` first to validate the arguments and preview the exact request without sending it to Polarion. The executor returns this preview as normal text, and as structured content when the tool declares an output schema.

dry_run.description: If true, validates the request and returns the exact request that would be sent to Polarion — with the Authorization header redacted and any binary payload summarized by byte length — without actually sending it.

projectId.description: The Polarion project ID (its URL segment, e.g. `myproject`), case-sensitive. Required to scope the request to one project. If the ID is unknown, ask the user; getProjects lists IDs only with global read access.

requestBody.description: Parameters for overwriting multiple Work Item Document Parts.

partIds.description: The list of Document Part IDs to overwrite.

spaceId.description: The Document Space ID (a folder-like grouping of documents/pages within a project). Use `_default` (no quotes) to address the project's default space.

name: overwriteDocumentParts

overwrittenParts.description: Array of Part ID mappings showing old and new IDs.

newPartId.description: New Part ID after overwrite operation.

oldPartId.description: Original Part ID before overwrite operation.
